assertions.title: Sidebar is implemented as a swipe-from-left drawer using React Native Gesture Handler or equivalent; gesture configuration exists in code.

steps.expected: Uses React Native Gesture Handler or Expo Router drawer
steps.observed: Imports Gesture, GestureDetector from react-native-gesture-handler and implements PanGesture for edgeSwipeGesture and drawerPanGesture

assertions.title: Drawer content mirrors web sidebar content: navigation links, workspace info, user avatar — using the same Tailwind classes and tokens.

steps.expected: Matching navigation links, workspace info, user avatar
steps.observed: Both use the same structure for Workspace info, User Avatar, Calendar Preview (SidebarCalendar), and Calendars list.

steps.expected: Shared tailwind classes and tokens without hardcoded colors
steps.observed: Mobile uses same classes e.g. 'text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground', 'size-10 rounded-xl shadow-none', 'text-muted-foreground' as web.

summary: Tested 2 assertions via static code review and compilation checks: 2 passed. Verified PanGesture implementation for swipe-from-left drawer and confirmed styling/content parity between mobile drawer and web sidebar.
